summary: Yanked files were rejected during candidate selection but retained when registry distributions were aggregated for lockfile serialization. The fix excludes non-allowed yanked wheels and source distributions from both aggregation paths, while the updated integration regression verifies wheel-selected and source-selected lockfiles and preserves explicitly allowed yanks.
